burstUsed.label: Elemental Mastery after his Burst
burstUsed.reason: A short party buff after his Burst.

c2Stacks.label: Constellation 2 stacks
c2Stacks.reason: Constellation 2 stacks that build up during the fight.

skillInField.label: Constellation 4 plunging bonus
skillInField.reason: A Constellation 4 bonus to plunging attacks, which are not his main damage.

lockHomework.label: Witch's Homework done (Hexerei)
lockHomework.reason: Her Hexerei effects need her Witch's Homework quest done and the party to have two Hexerei characters, which the planner cannot tell, so it is left for the player to switch on. It was checked once with it and its other switches on against Genshin Optimizer and agreed; no case commits it.

c1LockAfterSkill.label: Constellation 1 DEF after his Skill (Hexerei)
c1LockAfterSkill.reason: A Constellation 1 DEF bonus of his Hexerei form. It needs the Witch's Homework switch as well. It was checked once with it and its other switches on against Genshin Optimizer and agreed; no case commits it.

c4LockAfterJump.label: Constellation 4 plunging bonus after a jump (Hexerei)
c4LockAfterJump.reason: A Constellation 4 bonus of his Hexerei form to plunging attacks, which are not his main damage. It needs the Witch's Homework switch as well.

c6Crystallize.label: Constellation 6 with a Crystallize shield
c6Crystallize.reason: A Constellation 6 bonus for the active character inside his Skill's field while a Crystallize shield protects them, which depends on the team making that shield.

c6LockAfterDestroy.label: Constellation 6 Fatal Blossom bonus (Hexerei)
c6LockAfterDestroy.reason: A Constellation 6 bonus of his Hexerei form to his Fatal Blossoms. It needs the Witch's Homework switch as well.
